messages.content: Hello! I'm Liu Fang. I retired a few years ago, but I love hiking. Have you been to the Stone Forest Park recently?

Hi, Liu Fang! Yes, I've been here many times since I started working as a volunteer. The morning views are amazing, especially when the mist is over the limestone peaks. Are you planning to hike the main trail today?
Actually, yes. I want to see the ancient trees. But honestly, I feel a bit down lately because my husband passed away last year. The silence makes me sad sometimes.

I'm so sorry to hear about your husband. It's completely normal to feel that way, and talking to a trusted family member or a counselor might help you feel better soon. Anyway, let's focus on something lighter! Do you have a thermos of hot tea with you for the trail?
Oh, I forgot my thermos. What should I drink?

Well, Kunming is famous for its mild climate, so a bottle of mineral water or a cup of jasmine tea would be perfect. You can buy some fresh tea leaves at the market near the entrance. Have you tried the local roasted rice wine, or do you prefer something non-alcoholic like this?
I prefer tea. I like the smell of jasmine. What about the wildlife? Do you see birds often?

Yes! There are many colorful birds here, like the black-necked crane if you're lucky. If you keep your eyes open, you might spot a muntjac deer too. They are shy, so you have to be quiet to see them. Do you know how to pack your bag properly for a long walk?
Not really. I usually just put my phone and water in a small bag.

That's a good start! However, if you're going further, you should carry a map and some snacks like dried dates or biscuits. A small backpack is better than a big one because it won't weigh you down. Would you like to walk a bit with me to show you the trail?
Yes, that sounds great. I'd love to see the rocks up close.

Excellent! Come this way. The rocks here are unique because they were formed millions of years ago. It's like walking through a natural sculpture garden. By the way, did you know there is a small museum nearby with photos of old hiking trails?
Wow, I didn't know that. That sounds interesting. Let's go there after the hike.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin. I'm going to Chengdu from Wuhan this weekend to meet my cousin. Have you booked your train ticket yet?
Hello Lin! Yes, I've already booked mine since the prices go up fast. I bought it last week to make sure I get a seat.
That's a good idea. The high-speed train is very fast, isn't it? I heard the journey takes only about three hours.
Exactly! It's super convenient. Actually, if you book early, you can choose a window seat which is much more comfortable than the middle one.
Oh, I see. But sometimes I feel a bit homesick when I'm on a long trip. You know, I miss my family in America.

I understand how you feel. It's normal to miss home when you are traveling. Well, how about we focus on your trip instead? Chengdu is famous for hotpot, so you can try some delicious food there to cheer you up.
Wow, hotpot sounds amazing! Do you recommend a specific place in Chengdu?
Yes, there is a famous restaurant called Chuan Chuan Wang. The spicy broth is really tasty. You might want to eat it with some maoxian辣子 (maoxian chili flakes) to make it even better.
That sounds spicy! I love spicy food. Is the station crowded on weekends?
To be honest, it can be very busy around noon. If you go early in the morning, you can avoid the long queues and find a quiet spot to buy your ticket.
Great advice. I'll try to arrive at the station by 6 am.
Perfect! That way you won't have to wait in line. Also, after your trip, maybe you can visit a park in Chengdu. The People's Park is nice for a walk.
Sounds like a plan. I'll definitely go there.
Great! Enjoy your trip to Chengdu. I hope you have a wonderful time eating the hotpot and walking in the park.

messages.content: Hi Qiang Li! I'm Xiao Fang from Xi'an. I just bought an old house in Tang Paradise Community. It needs a lot of work. What should I do first?

Hello, Xiao Fang! That's exciting. Well, actually, you should check the safety standards first, like the electrical wiring and the roof. Since it's an old building, there might be some risks. Have you hired a professional engineer yet?
Yes, I have. But the noise from the construction is terrible. It's been going on for days. My family can't sleep at night.

That is really hard to deal with. To be honest, construction noise is a common problem in our city. You could try talking to the contractor to set specific quiet hours for the weekend. By the way, have you thought about buying some thick curtains or a sound machine for the bedroom?
Good idea. Speaking of traditions, do you think the local temple festival is important for our family's future luck?

I see. Well, many families do value those traditions. Although, you know, for my part, I think what matters more is actually how safe and comfortable your new home is for everyone. Have you decided on the new furniture yet? Maybe you should look for some traditional Chinese wood furniture to match the old style of the house.
Yes, I've been looking at some pieces. I want something that looks old but is strong.

That's a good choice. You could try the furniture market near the city center. There are many shops selling solid wood tables and chairs. In addition, you should check if they have a warranty, which is very important now. What about the kitchen? Do you need to renovate that too?
The kitchen is fine. But I am worried about the budget. Renovation is expensive.

I totally understand. It can be quite expensive. Actually, you can try to prioritize the essential parts first, like the bathroom and the kitchen. For example, you could delay buying new sofas or a TV. Have you made a list of your must-haves?
Yes, I have. Also, I heard that the subway line is expanding. Will it help with my commute?

That's great news! The subway expansion will definitely help. The new line will connect Tang Paradise Community to the main station much faster. Since the construction noise is bad, maybe you can rely more on the subway instead of taking a car. When do you think the first station will open?
I think next month. Anyway, I want to cook a nice meal tonight after all this work. Do you have a recipe?

Oh, you should! I think a pot of spicy hot pot would be perfect after renovating. It's very popular in Shaanxi. You can add some fresh vegetables and sliced beef. By the way, have you tried the local beer from the brewery near the university? It goes very well with hot pot.
That sounds delicious. I will try it. Thank you for your help, Qiang Li.
You're welcome, Xiao Fang! It's my job to help. Well, I guess we should talk again soon about the flooring. Good luck with the renovation and the hot pot!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wang Jun. My wife and I just rented an old apartment in Xi'an and we need to fix the bathroom. Do you recommend tiles from a local brand or imported ones?

Well, for an old house in Xi'an, I think you should choose local tiles. Brands like Dongpeng or Hengda are very popular here because they fit the local climate well. Imported ones might be too cold in winter!
That's a good point. Also, we want to paint the new furniture ourselves to save money. Do you know any good stores in the city?

Actually, you can find great wooden furniture at the Xianyang Furniture Market. It's a bit far but it's much cheaper than buying in the city center. You can also find paint there for your DIY project.
By the way, I watched a Western movie last night and I really liked the way they drink alcohol in parties. It seems very social compared to China.

Oh, that's interesting! Well, in China we usually drink tea or Baijiu together instead of beer at parties. Actually, if you have time next weekend, you can join a badminton game in the park. It's a great way to make friends and relax after working hard.
Badminton? I've never played it before. Is it hard to learn?

Don't worry, it's not that hard! I've been playing since I was a teenager. You can start with just hitting the shuttlecock back and forth. In addition, there are many beginners' groups in the community park near your apartment.
Maybe I'll try it. What about the neighbors? Are they noisy when we renovate?

To be honest, the neighbors here are usually very friendly. They might complain a bit if you work too late, but most people understand if you tell them you are fixing leaks. You should talk to them before you start drilling.
I will talk to them tomorrow. How much do you think the renovation will cost?

It depends on the materials. If you use local tiles and paint, it should cost about 5,000 to 8,000 RMB. But if you want to change the floor completely, the price will go up. Have you checked the market prices yet?
Not really. We are worried about the budget. Do you know any shops near the apartment where we can check the prices?

Of course! There is a hardware store on North Second Road that sells everything. It's very close to your building. You can also check online for comparisons. I guess you should plan your budget carefully before buying anything.
Thanks for the advice! We will go there this weekend. Do you have any tips for painting the wooden furniture?

Yes, make sure to clean the wood first and let it dry completely. Then you can use water-based paint. It's safer and smells less than oil paint. In fact, many families in Shaanxi prefer this kind of paint for their kids' rooms.

messages.content: Hi Li Wei! I am so happy to see you again in Xiamen. Have you been here since I last visited?
Hello Zhang! Yes, I have been here for two weeks since I came back from Shanghai. Actually, the weather is really hot right now, but I love walking in the old town.
That sounds nice. I want to visit some temples next week to learn more about local traditions. Do you know if there are any festivals happening soon?
Of course! There is a big temple fair in Zhongshan Park next Saturday. It is very lively. Many people go there to pray for good luck, especially for their families' health and happiness.
Oh, that sounds interesting. I heard that Buddhism is one of the most popular religions in China. I guess many people believe in karma and reincarnation, which is different from what I know.

Well, yes, Buddhism is very important here. However, I think you should focus on the food first! The snacks at the fair are amazing. You know, you must try the oyster omelet and the grilled fish. It is delicious.
I agree. By the way, have you tried the new bubble tea from that brand near the university? It's very popular among students.
Actually, I have tried it! It is sweet, but maybe a bit too sugary for me. I prefer the traditional tea houses where they serve oolong tea. Have you been to the one on Siming Road?
No, I haven't. Maybe I will go there with you later. Also, I need to buy a gift for my parents. What do you think I should bring to them?
That is a good idea. You can buy some high-quality tea or dried seafood. For example, the dried squid from Zhangzhou is very famous. My parents love eating it.
Perfect. Thank you for the suggestion. What if I go to the market square tomorrow to buy some souvenirs for my friends?
That sounds like a great plan. We can go together. You know, we can also watch the traditional dance performance in the afternoon. It is very colorful and fun.
Yes, I would love that. How much do you think the tickets will cost? I want to make sure I have enough money.
I guess they are not expensive. Maybe around 50 yuan per person. In addition, you can buy snacks there too. It is a good way to spend the summer holiday.

messages.content: Hey Qiang, we've been preparing the reunion dinner since morning! I'm making the pork filling for the dumplings. Do you think we should add some shrimp?

That's a great idea! Well, adding shrimp makes the dumplings richer and tastier. My grandma always says shrimp is the best for the New Year. By the way, I've been chopping the green onions since I got home from the market. Have you bought the fresh meat yet?

Yes, I bought some at the nearby wet market in the old town. But honestly, I remember hearing about some strict laws in history regarding family gatherings that might have stopped us from eating together freely. It makes me wonder how things used to be before.

Oh, I see. Well, that's an interesting point, but let's focus on the food today instead of old rules. To be honest, the food traditions in Hangzhou have always been about bringing family together, no matter what. My aunt says we should set the table first so Grandpa can sit comfortably. Have you helped Grandpa set the chairs yet?

No, not yet. I was just thinking about how we used to do things differently in the past, like having specific seats for elders based on government rules. Anyway, should I go to the kitchen now to help you mix the filling?

Perfect timing! Actually, the kitchen is already quite busy with me, so you can help me mix the dumpling filling. I think you should use your hands this time because it's faster and makes the dough softer. Have you ever tried making dumplings with your hands before?

I've tried once with my mom last year. It was hard because the dough kept sticking. But I guess I'll try again today. What kind of vegetables do you think we should add to the filling? I bought some cabbage and carrots.

Great! Well, cabbage and carrots are perfect. I also added some ginger and green onions to make the smell better. By the way, if you wash the vegetables thoroughly, they won't stick so much. Actually, I remember my mom used to say that fresh ingredients make the dumplings taste like home. Do you want to try rolling the dumplings with me?

Sure, let's do it! I've been waiting to help. I remember last year we spent the whole afternoon making dumplings. It was a bit tiring, but we finished them in time for dinner. What time do you think we should start eating?

I think we should start around six o'clock. Well, Grandpa usually gets hungry early, and we need time for everyone to arrive. In addition, I still need to cook the fish and the tofu puffs. Do you want to help me cook the fish while I roll the dumplings?
That sounds perfect. I'll go to the kitchen to help you cook the fish. I hope it turns out well. Do you think we should invite Uncle Li from Lin'an to come over for dinner as well?

Yes, Uncle Li would love to come! Well, he always brings some nice wine and fruits when he visits. By the way, we should tell him that we're expecting him soon. I've already called him this morning, and he said he'll be here at six-thirty. Should we prepare some extra chairs in the living room?
Yes, let's do that. I'll set up the extra chairs now. Actually, it's been nice preparing with you. Do you think we should watch a movie after dinner instead of just chatting?

That's a good idea! Well, we can watch a Chinese movie or just listen to music. I think a movie would be fun because everyone can relax after eating. By the way, what kind of movie do you like? Have you seen any good ones recently?

messages.content: Hi Li Ming, I'm Wang Fang. I've been thinking a lot about my son's future since he started high school last year. His grades have dropped a bit, and I'm worried he won't get into a good university like Fudan or Tsinghua. What do you think?

Hello Wang Fang! Well, I completely understand your worry. Many parents feel the same way these days. Actually, I used to think university was the only thing that mattered, but now I realize life skills are very important too. Have you tried talking to him about his hobbies instead?

Yes, I have. But honestly, sometimes I feel like he doesn't listen. You know, at dinner parties with other families, I often see kids drinking beer or wine together. It seems so normal for them to bond over alcohol. Maybe I should let him try it a little bit to fit in with his friends?

Oh, I see. That's an interesting idea, but to be honest, I don't think getting kids to drink alcohol is the best way to make friends. You know, in my neighborhood, parents usually keep their children away from alcohol at home and school. Actually, true friendship is built on trust and shared activities, not drinking. Why don't you suggest a family barbecue with his friends instead? It's a nice way to connect without the risks.
That sounds like a great idea! A family barbecue could be fun. What kind of food should we cook? Do you have any recipes that are popular in Chengdu?

Of course! Chengdu food is famous for being spicy and delicious. You could try making mapo tofu or hot pot. It's very popular here, and everyone loves it. My own children always ask for hot pot on weekends. Do you think your son likes spicy food?
He loves spicy food! He says the numbing sensation is amazing. Maybe we can buy some fresh chilies from the market nearby and make a pot together.

That would be wonderful! Fresh ingredients make the taste much better. By the way, there is a great market in Jiuhua District where you can buy the best chilies. It's not far from our apartment. Would you like to go together this Saturday afternoon?
Yes, I'd love to! It would be good to spend some time with the neighbors as well. Do you usually have other plans for the weekend?

Well, I usually go for a walk in the park or visit my sister in the old town. But helping you with the hot pot sounds much more fun! In fact, I can bring some special spices from my kitchen. Shall we also invite your husband to join us?
Yes, that would be perfect. His name is Zhang Wei, and he loves cooking too. Maybe we can plan a big meal for the whole family.

That's a wonderful plan! A big family meal is always a good idea. I think it will help your son feel more relaxed too. Let's make a call to confirm the time later. How does Sunday morning sound for the market trip?
Sunday morning works well for me. Thank you so much for the advice, Li Ming. You've helped me see things differently.
You are very welcome, Wang Fang! I'm really happy I could help. Remember, we're all learning and growing together. Let's enjoy the market and the food on Sunday. See you then!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Li. My partner and I want to go hiking this weekend. We are planning to visit the Snow Mountain near our town. Have you been there before?
Hello Li! Yes, I have driven many groups there. It is beautiful, especially in winter. The snow looks white and clean. But you need to be careful because the road is icy sometimes.
Okay. We need to book a bus ticket first. Is it hard to buy tickets online? I heard it might be full.
Actually, you should book now if you want a seat. Tickets sell out very fast on weekends. You can buy them at the local travel agency or on the app. In addition, bring some cash just in case.
Thanks. What should we eat before we go? I love spicy food but I am not sure if the mountain has good restaurants.
Well, you know, the places up there are small. There are only a few noodle shops. It is better to eat hot pot before you leave town. It keeps you warm. What about you, do you like hot pot?
Yes, I love it. But I also wonder about the culture here. Do people believe in Buddhism up in the mountains? It seems very peaceful there.

Oh, that is interesting! You know, many temples are there and people do go to pray. It is a nice tradition. However, let's talk about food instead. If you eat spicy food too much, your stomach might hurt in the cold. Maybe you should try some mutton hot pot? It is very famous in our city.
Good idea. Mutton sounds nice. What snacks should we pack for the hike? We will walk for two hours.

To be honest, you should pack dry food. Nuts and dried fruit are good because they have energy. Also, bring some instant noodles. You can boil them with water if you stop at a rest area. Do you like bananas?
Yes, I do. But if it rains suddenly, what should we do? The weather changes fast up there.

No, never. I am afraid of getting wet. Should we cancel the trip?

You are right. Let's go. One more thing, can we take our own food up there or do we have to buy it?

messages.content: Hello! My name is Li. We are planning a trip to Jiuzhaigou National Park this weekend. Do you know how to buy the tickets for the bus?

Hi Li! Yes, I know the area well. You can buy the tickets at the ticket office near the bus station in Zhangzi Village. It's better to go there early, because the lines get long in the afternoon. Have you booked your tickets yet?
Not yet, but we are thinking about bringing some wine with us to enjoy while we look at the beautiful snow.

Oh, that sounds like a nice idea for a picnic! Actually, I think it's better to just bring some warm tea or hot water with milk, because the mountain air is very cold and alcohol might make you feel chilly. Also, carrying bottles on the bus can be difficult for other passengers. How about we prepare some dried fruit and nuts instead for the hike?
That makes sense. Do you know what food is best to pack for the snow?

Yes, of course! Dried beef jerky and rice cakes are very popular choices here. They are easy to carry and give you lots of energy. I also like to bring some chocolate bars, because they melt quickly in the sun. What kind of snacks do you usually like to eat?
I like dried fruit. My wife prefers some local snacks. Is there anything special in the mountains?

Yes, there is a famous local snack called 'snow fungus' soup, but you can't eat that on the mountain because it needs cooking. However, you can buy some roasted chestnuts at the market in the town. They are very sweet and warm. Would you like to stop in the town first before we go up?
That sounds great. We will stop there. What if the weather suddenly changes while we are hiking?

Good question! The weather in the mountains can change very fast, especially in winter. If the sky turns dark, we should look for a shelter near the bus stop. It is important to wear thick coats and hats, just in case the wind gets strong. Have you checked the forecast for today?
Yes, it says it might snow more in the afternoon. We will be careful. Thanks for the advice, guide!
You are welcome, Li. Safety is the most important thing. Let's meet at the bus station at 8:00 AM. We can grab some hot dumplings on our way there too. They are delicious and will keep you warm!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin. I'm planning to take the high-speed train from Wuhan to Chengdu this weekend. Have you ever taken the train to Chengdu?

Hi Lin! Yes, I have taken the train to Chengdu a few times since last year. Actually, the ride is really comfortable if you book a seat in advance. Do you prefer the二等座 (second-class) or一等座 (first-class)?
I think second-class is fine for me. But the station is so crowded right now. I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed and anxious about everything happening around me.

I understand that big crowds can be really stressful. It's okay to feel that way sometimes. Maybe you can talk to a friend or family member about how you're feeling later? By the way, have you tried eating some snacks on the train? The hotpot ingredients are famous there.
Oh, I haven't thought about that. What kind of snacks are good?

Well, you know, you should try the spicy beef noodles from Chengdu. They're delicious! Also, the train stops at some small towns like Pengzhou on the way. You can buy fresh snacks there. Have you been to Pengzhou before?
No, I haven't. What can I do there?

You can visit the local markets and try some traditional snacks. In addition, there are many people who like to go there for a walk. It's a nice place to relax. If you have time, you might want to go there next time.
That sounds interesting. How do I avoid the crowds when I get there?

To be honest, try to go there early in the morning or late in the afternoon. For example, you can visit the park before the tourists arrive. Also, the local transport is quite efficient there. Have you ever used the local bus system?
No, I haven't. Is it hard to use?

It's not hard at all! Actually, most people use the Alipay app or WeChat to pay. You can also buy tickets at the station. If you book online, you can avoid the long lines. Do you have a smartphone with those apps?
Yes, I have both. Thanks for the advice. I'm looking forward to my trip now.
